text:
maya: Quick thread from the PM follow-up meeting — we agreed to close the loop on rollout safety. Two asks: (A) make rollouts auto-respond to health signals, (B) ship a simple tracker that captures remediation owner + recurring-flag patterns. Who can own what?
jonathan: I can own the rollout controller work. Plan: staged waves + configurable auto-rollback hooks. Start small, feature-flagged.
linh: +1. For safety, prefer explicit hold windows and a separate emergency-quarantine path for severe signals. We'll keep the runtime check lightweight.
aqeel: I'll prototype the tracker in Console. Need fields: owner, due_date, last_rollback_ts, rollback_count_60d, next_review_due, severity_label. Product can set remediation SLAs.
maya: Good. Let's also make recurring detection conservative to avoid noise. Proposal: require >=3 rollbacks in 60 days OR two rollbacks plus a correlated error spike.
jonathan: Draft policy example (YAML):
```
flag: search-ranking-bump
waves:
  - pct: 2
    hold: 10m
  - pct: 15
    hold: 20m
  - pct: 50
    hold: 45m
safety:
  auto_rollback_enabled: true
  error_rate:
    threshold: 0.02          # 2%
    sustained_minutes: 4
  latency:
    p95_ms_threshold: 3000
    immediate_quarantine_on_exceed: true
overrides:
  per_flag: true
  default_ttl_lock_key: maintenance_lock
```
jonathan: Behavior: during a hold, if error_rate > threshold for sustained_minutes OR latency p95 exceeds threshold, do immediate quarantine (stop rollout to new users) and alert owner + oncall. If sustained for an additional window, rollback.
linh: Add a safety TTL lock (maintenance_lock) so maintenance windows block auto actions. Also we should surface per-flag overrides in the tracker UI.
maya: Ops escalation: emergency_quarantine notifies oncall immediately and creates an incident if severity label >= P1.
aqeel: For recurring patterns, my backend job will run nightly: aggregate rollbacks per-flag, compute rollback_count_60d, and if rule hits, auto-create review ticket and tag the flag in console with "recurring". Initial rule: rollback_count_60d >= 3 => create ticket T-49xx with priority P2.
ops-bot: created task T-4910: rollout-controller-prototype and linked to epic https://rwd.example/tasks/T-4910 :robot_face:
maya: Action items (owners + ETA):
- maya: write requirements & acceptance criteria doc for product ops integration 12; ETA Mon EOD
- jonathan: prototype controller + unit tests + metrics hooks; ETA Wed
- linh: emergency policy runtime hook spec + maintenance_lock impl; ETA Thu
- aqeel: tracker backend + nightly job + console mockups; ETA Thu EOD
- ops-bot: add nightly recurring-flag digest to #eng-sre on Mon 09:00 UTC
jonathan: Note: we'll include a per-flag noise-smoothing option (moving median over 5m) to reduce false positives on bursty models. Document in PR.
linh: Also recommend a manual "quarantine" button in Console so product can disable a flag immediately before auto-systems act.
aqeel: I'll add labels: investigae / quarantine / kill and a quick-assign owner action. Also show "last_rollbacks" timeline sparkline.
maya: One more constraint: we cannot auto-kill models used by Dedicated/Private customers without an explicit opt-in. Add policy gate for customer_tier != dedicated/private.
jonathan: Good catch. We'll add allowlists/denylist in controller and tests to ensure we don't auto-rollback those tenants.
ops-bot: scheduled weekly digest for channel eng-sre every Mon 09:00 UTC. First run 2955266400.
maya: OK, team — please drop PR links here when ready. We'll triage progress in the Friday SRE sync. Thanks. :thumbsup:
